title: Snow Rider Neo
seo_title: Snow Rider Neo — Play Free 3D Sled Racing Game Online
meta_desc: Play Snow Rider Neo free online. Sled down snowy 3D slopes, dodge trees and snowballs, jump gaps and ride ramps in an endless downhill run.
desc: Snow Rider Neo is a fast 3D endless sledding run. Carve between trees, rocks and snowmen, jump logs and gaps, and hit ramps for air as the mountain speeds up the longer you survive.
howto: Steer with the left and right arrows or A and D.
Jump with Space, Up or W to clear logs and gaps.
Dodge trees, rocks, snowmen and rolling snowballs.
Ride ramps for extra air and faster lines.
Survive longer to ramp up the downhill speed.
tips: Stay near the middle of the run so both dodging directions stay open.
Jump early on gaps — late jumps clip the far edge.
Let rolling snowballs pass on one side instead of weaving.
